description: Three searches over a complete corpus. The first is lexical: candidates come back ranked, each with a locator naming a note and a section, and every section of one note carries that note's source_record_id — so several hits inside one note are several candidates and one piece of evidence, and this source cannot corroborate itself. One of the notes declares a sensitivity of its own, which raises the source floor for that candidate and could never lower it. The second search names the ticket a note declares as an alias: an exact identifier hit, promoted as a partition ahead of every scored candidate. Tags are deliberately not aliases, or `policy` would be an exact hit on everything anyone ever tagged with it. The third carries as_of, which this adapter declares it can filter: the note written after the boundary is excluded because its own event time says so, not because the index was rebuilt — which is the difference between `filter` and `snapshot` support.
